text:
alex_ops: FYI vendor told us last night: two H100 pallets delayed ~10 business days into southern EU (Marseille) due to carrier re-route. need RMA split plan and provisional routing.
ivan_vendor: sorry about that — transshipment backlog in FRA. we can air-top up 8 units now, rest via sea. will provide AWBs by EOD.
dani_procurement: what's the impact on committed allocation for dedicated pools? we have 48 H100s reserved for Q2.
laura_fleet: depends how many of the 48 are on these pallets. early estimate: 24 on this shipment, 8 can be air-expedited, 16 will be delayed. current spare pool covers ~6, so we need alternate plan.
sam_sre: can we reassign some jobs to A100s temporarily? cost vs perf tradeoff? need list of affected clusters.
alex_ops: good point @sam_sre — i'll pull per-cluster allocations and flag canary jobs. short term fallback to A100s for non-latency-critical trials.
ivan_vendor: AWBs: we have two provisional air AWBs and one master ocean BL — sending in thread in 10. insurance carrier asking HS classification confirmation for customs.
dani_procurement: send AWBs here and invoice PO refs. we need to decide cost-share if we convert part to air (vendor covers partial surcharge?)
ivan_vendor: vendor can cover 50% of air surcharge for urgent 8 units. remaining surcharge to customer.
laura_fleet: RMA question: several units shipped are marked as 'DOA suspect' from staging photos. can we split RMA handling (air units -> direct desk repair; sea units -> depot in Marseille)?
alex_ops: yes split routing makes sense. prioritize sending serial manifests and depot acceptance SLA. can we get Marseille depot acceptance window?
ivan_vendor: Marseille depot open M-F 08:00-16:00, accepts RMA consignments if pre-notified 48h. otherwise crossdock hold.
sam_sre: add note: region network egress capacity to Marseille cluster is limited; we should avoid mass redeploys during depot acceptance. coordinate with infra scheduler.
dani_procurement: to be explicit on cost: vendor pays 50% air surcharge, Redwood covers depot handling fees and customs duty if classification changes. need written ack.
ivan_vendor: ack — will send a formal credit memo for 50% surcharge.
rma-bot: rma created: RMA-2026-0456, tracker link: https://rma.redwood.internal/RMA-2026-0456 — assigned to Marseille depot. Please attach photos and PO.
laura_fleet: throwing in the HS code convos: customs is flagging H100s under 8471 vs 8543, which changes duties. legal is reviewing. any immediate action?
dani_procurement: hold payments pending duty clarification? finance prefers not to block but we can set aside contingency.
alex_ops: action items: 1) @ivan_vendor send AWBs + serial manifest (EOD) 2) @laura_fleet confirm depot pre-notify and acceptance slot (tomorrow morning) 3) @sam_sre produce cluster fallback list (today) 4) @dani_procurement draft surcharge credit ack.
ivan_vendor: AWBs attached:
```
AIR1: AWB1234567890
AIR2: AWB1234567891
OCEAN: BLMS1234567
SERIALS: H100-1001,H100-1002,H100-1003,H100-1004,H100-1005,H100-1006,H100-1007,H100-1008, ...
```
laura_fleet: pre-notify done for Marseille 09:30 tomorrow. depot asked for packing photos + thermal log for each pallet.
sam_sre: cluster fallback list attached (short table): non-critical training jobs -> A100 pools; latency services stay on smaller subset. will throttle redeploys during intake.
dani_procurement: drafting credit ack now, will loop in finance and legal. penciling contingency ~€12k for duties/clearance.
alex_ops: OK thanks. if depot flags DOA after acceptance we run standard RMA replacement workflow but hold replacements until manifest verification. keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
ivan_vendor: will follow up with scanned AWB + BL documents and expected ETAs. apologies again — working to avoid repeat.
laura_fleet: one more: can we route any sea units via Antwerp if Marseille customs blocks? what's the delta?
ivan_vendor: routing via ANT adds 2-3 days but better customs processing; cost delta ~€600 per pallet.
dani_procurement: add Antwerp as fallback, vendor to confirm alternate BL re-issue if we choose.
sam_sre: noted — I'll add a hold window in deployment automation for 72h around expected intake to avoid job churn.
alex_ops: last_message: leaving action checklist in GH issue and will update with AWBs/credit memo. thanks everyone.
